characters.description: A middle-aged Ethiopian man in his early forties with short curly hair greying at the temples and a neat dark beard, wearing faded navy-blue overalls with a pencil tucked behind his ear.
An older Ethiopian man in his early fifties with greying curly hair and a thick grey beard, wearing faded navy-blue overalls with a pencil tucked behind his ear.
A curious eight-year-old Habesha boy with a round expressive face, big dark eyes, and short black hair, wearing an oversized mustard yellow T-shirt and dark blue shorts.
A tall lanky fifteen-year-old Habesha teenage boy with short curly black hair, wearing a cozy mustard yellow hoodie with rolled-up sleeves and simple dark blue jeans.
A young Habesha man in his mid-twenties with short dark hair and a neatly trimmed beard, wearing a mustard yellow button-up overshirt over a plain white T-shirt.

logline: A son remembers how his Habesha father fixed everything at home himself, always starting with the same calm words, until the day the son fixes something alone and calls to tell him.

cues.caption: Acoustic Ethiopian Tizita music with gentle krar strumming, warm acoustic guitar chords, and soft washint flute melody.
cues.intent: Nostalgic and warm Ethiopian Tizita melody carrying family warmth and memory.

props.description: A heavy metal toolbox painted bright red, marked with minor scratches and oil stains, featuring a sturdy silver latch and black top handle.
A vintage white sedan car with rounded headlights, slightly faded white paint, and minor bumper wear.
A traditional Ethiopian residential yard featuring cream stucco walls, corrugated iron roof, sky-blue gate, surrounding eucalyptus trees, and a black water tank.

shots.image_prompt: Close-up shot of the red toolbox resting on a wooden stool in a bright sunlit compound yard.
shots.motion_prompt: dust particles glint gently in the morning sunbeam, camera pushes in slowly

narration.text: My father never hired anyone. If something broke at home, he fixed it himself.

shots.reason: Establishes the central object of the story and sets a quiet, nostalgic tone.

shots.image_prompt: Medium-wide shot of the father walking across the compound yard with the red toolbox, with the boy following right behind him.
shots.motion_prompt: the father walks forward steadily while the boy trots behind him, camera tracks right

narration.text: Wherever he carried his heavy red toolbox, I was right behind him.

shots.reason: Shows the father-son dynamic where the boy always follows his father to help.

shots.image_prompt: Medium shot of the father lying under the old white car while the boy kneels beside holding a flashlight in the compound.
shots.motion_prompt: flashlight beam wavers slightly as the boy holds it, camera static

narration.text: Lying under our old car, I held the torch steady while grease stained his sleeves.

shots.reason: Illustrates hands-on learning and shared quiet work under the family car.

shots.image_prompt: Close-up shot of the father's hands using a wooden hand plane on a coffee table frame, wood shavings curling around.
shots.motion_prompt: hand plane slides across smooth wood sending curling shavings floating, camera pulls back

narration.text: I watched wood shavings curl from his plane as he built our coffee table.

shots.reason: Highlights craftsmanship and focus on details through close-up of hands.

shots.image_prompt: Medium shot of the father holding a voltage tester near an electrical box in a dimly lit living room, with the boy watching in awe by candlelight.
shots.motion_prompt: candle flame flickers softly illuminating their faces, camera pushes in slowly

narration.text: When the power cut out and dark fell, everyone panicked. But Dad just grabbed his tester.

shots.reason: Introduces Dad's key phrase during a home crisis moment.

shots.beat: Plumbing repair and lesson on patience
shots.image_prompt: Close-up shot of the father's hands using a wrench to tighten a brass pipe fixture, with the boy watching closely.
shots.motion_prompt: wrench turns slightly with deliberate care, camera static

narration.text: He tightened every leaking pipe. He taught me that patience was his secret tool.

shots.reason: Emphasizes patience as a core lesson passed down from father to son.

shots.image_prompt: Close-up shot of water dripping slowly from a brass tap into a sink, then stopping as hands tighten the valve.
shots.motion_prompt: one last water drop falls into the sink, camera static

narration.text: He never rushed. He worked in silence until everything worked again.

shots.reason: Captures the quiet satisfaction of a job finished properly.

shots.beat: The turn: teenage son fixing the car
shots.image_prompt: Medium shot of the teenage son holding a wrench near the old white car while the father stands beside him with folded arms, smiling.
shots.motion_prompt: the father smiles proudly with arms folded while the teenage son turns the wrench, camera pulls back

narration.text: Years later, he stepped back, folded his arms, and passed me the wrench.

narration.subtitle: Slowly, slowly, the egg walks on its own legs.

shots.reason: Marks the transition as the teenage son takes over the wrench under Dad's proud watch.

shots.beat: The handover: adult son opens the toolbox
shots.image_prompt: Close-up shot of the grown son opening the red toolbox inside a cozy modern apartment kitchen.
shots.motion_prompt: the grown son unlatches the red toolbox lid softly, camera pushes in slow

narration.text: When I moved out, he gave me the toolbox. So when my own tap leaked, I opened the latch.

shots.reason: Shows the inherited legacy when the grown son faces his own repair in his own home.

shots.image_prompt: Medium split-screen shot showing the grown son on the left calling from his apartment and the father today on the right answering in the compound.

layers.image_prompt: Medium shot of the grown son holding a wrench and speaking on a phone in a bright modern apartment kitchen.
layers.motion_prompt: the grown son nods gently while talking on the phone, camera static

layers.image_prompt: Medium shot of the father today standing in the sunlit compound holding a phone to his ear and smiling.
layers.motion_prompt: the father today speaks softly into the phone with a warm smile, camera static

shots.motion_prompt: the grown son talks cheerfully while the father smiles into his phone, camera static

narration.text: I fixed it myself, then called him.

shots.reason: Resolves the emotional arc: father and son connecting across generations through accomplishment.
